assist.exactQuestion: Acquire source-addressed downside, execution-risk and falsifier evidence Alpha can reuse without setting Alpha's numeric risk or score.

claims.claim: A senior business-development and strategy executive moved to a part-time strategy role effective September 3, 2026 while an existing vice president continues to lead business development. This is a bounded execution-monitoring signal during Mobileye's multi-front ADAS, robotaxi and physical-AI expansion, not evidence by itself of commercial deterioration.
causalEdges: leadership continuity -> commercial execution capacity -> pipeline conversion
strategic breadth -> coordination load -> execution sensitivity

risks.risk: Leadership-role transition can increase coordination and continuity risk while Mobileye is expanding beyond its core supplier model, but the filing simultaneously documents continuity of business-development leadership and therefore does not support a present operational-failure conclusion.

unknowns: No source-addressed evidence in the filing quantifies any effect on customer conversion, pipeline velocity, bookings, revenue or margins.
The reason for the transition and any change in operating responsibilities beyond the disclosed leadership continuity remain undisclosed.
falsifiers: Subsequent primary evidence showing stable or improving design-win conversion, customer awards and commercialization milestones under the continuing business-development leadership would reduce the relevance of this transition risk.
Conversely, source-backed evidence of customer losses, delayed awards or commercial execution disruption causally tied to leadership continuity would strengthen the risk.

gatingStatus.lawfulNextEvidencePath: Council Alpha may reuse the SEC-addressed governance/execution signal as bounded risk evidence while separately constructing Methodology 1.0 numeric underwriting and confidence evidence.

confidence: high on the disclosed transition and continuity; low on operating-impact inference

sources.title: Mobileye Global Inc. Form 8-K dated September 10, 2026
